question: Which of the following dynasties was NOT a part of the Delhi Sultanate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sur**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sur** dynasty was founded by **Sher Shah Suri **after defeating Mughal** king Humayun in The Battle of Chausa in 1539**.
 
• **Sur** originally belongs to **Afghanistan**.
 
• **Sur ruled North India** from **1540 to 1556**.
 
• **Sur last ruler Adil Shah Suri was defeated by Akbar in the 2nd battle of Panipat in 1556**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The period from **1206 A.D. to 1526 A.D.** came to be known as the **Delhi Sultanate period**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
